title: fix(types): the SDUI form option stops at the spec form-view option boundary; kind and default are refused (objectui#12736)
body:
Fixes #12736
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The SDUI form-option face (`SelectOption` in `packages/types/src/form.ts`) and its zod twin (`SelectOptionSchema` in `packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts`) now stop at the spec's form-view option boundary, `FormSelectOptionSchema` / `FormSelectOption` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, read by reference (triage scoping B, comment 6220534234).

**How the keys are derived.** Before: both faces read the spec's OBJECT-field option (`SelectOptionSchema` / `SelectOption` from `@objectstack/spec/data`). The type face did this through `SelectOptionBase` (`Omit` of the spec type), and the zod twin spread `stripImportedDefaults(SpecSelectOptionSchema).shape`. After:

- **Type face:** `SelectOption extends Omit of SelectOptionBase` over `'value'` plus `ObjectFieldOnlyOptionKey`. That key type is module-local and defined as `Exclude of keyof SpecSelectOption, keyof SpecFormSelectOption`: the set difference of the spec's two option types. It is never a hand-written list.
- **Zod twin:** it spreads `stripImportedDefaults(SpecFormSelectOptionSchema).shape`. It then adds `objectFieldOnlyOptionRefusals()`, one tombstone per key in the same set difference, computed from the two spec shapes.

The twin is a bare `z.object` (strip mode). Leaving the keys out would only change "accepted and silently ignored" into "stripped and silently ignored", so each key is declared unwritable and refused at parse.

## Accept-set changes (for the contract review)

| Face | Key | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SelectOption` (type) | `default` | optional `boolean` | not declared: a typed literal gets an excess-property error |
| `SelectOption` (type) | `kind` | optional `'open' \| 'won' \| 'lost'` (spec 18) | not declared: same |
| `SelectOptionSchema` (zod) | `default` | accepted and kept in the output | refused, `invalid_type` at path `default` |
| `SelectOptionSchema` (zod) | `kind` | accepted and kept in the output | refused, `invalid_type` at path `kind` |

The same refusal reaches everything that embeds the twin: `SelectSchema.options` and `FormFieldSchema.options` (zod), and `SelectSchema.options` / `FormField.options` (type). Nothing else moved:

- The other spec keys (`label`, `color`, `description`) are the form-view option's own members. The spec builds that option from the object-field shape by reference, minus the two keys.
- The four named divergences are kept, each with its reason in the new pin: `value` widened to `string | number | boolean`, the `visibleWhen` wire shape, and the objectui-only `disabled` and `icon`.
- `SelectOptionBase` and `SelectOptionMetadata` (the object-metadata face) keep `kind` and `default` unchanged. The spec takes both on a select or radio field's options.

**Semver:** `minor` for `@object-ui/types`. This is a breaking narrowing of a published type and zod schema. This repo's version policy (AGENTS.md, version-alignment section; enforced by `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`) marks objectui's own breaking changes `minor` and states the breaking meaning in the changeset text, because a `major` would move the whole fixed group off the `@objectstack` major. The changeset says the narrowing plainly.

**Producers (premise re-check before coding):** none. On `origin/main` 898bd2c069, no objectui source, example, fixture, docs snippet or test writes `kind` on any option, apart from the pins edited here. Every `default: true` option literal is on the OBJECT-field face: object schema `fields`, the field inspector, the metadata viewer, chart series, the plugin-form seed reader `schemaDefaultValues`, and `DetailViewFieldSchema`, which uses the spec schema. None is on the form face or this twin. No form renderer reads an option's `default` or `kind`.

## Pins edited deliberately (form face only), each with its reason beside it

- `select-option-tier1-convergence-7014.test.ts` (objectui#12711's set-difference pins). Each edit carries an `EDITED by objectui#12736` note with its reason. `PRE_CONVERGENCE_SelectOption` is not edited.
  - "kept every member" now excuses `default` only.
  - "gained only" is now `'description'`, plus a new "lost only `default`" pin.
  - The form-face `kind`-optional pin is replaced by "the form face has neither `kind` nor `default`".
  - "only `value` differs" becomes "`value` and the object-field-only keys differ", with the excusal on the metadata side only.
  - The form-face accepting literal drops `default`.
  - The object-metadata face pins are unchanged.
- `select-option-spec-parity.test.ts`: the spec keys are now read off `FormSelectOptionSchema`. The extensions are `disabled`, `icon` and the derived refusals. `default` left the "keeps stripped keys" fixture.
- `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`: a `MirroredUndeclared` row for `form.zod.ts#SelectOptionSchema`, keys `default` and `kind`, with its docblock. It has the same shape as the `operators` refusal row; the ledger figures moved to 3 entries / 4 keys, re-derived by the file's own census.
- `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`: `FormSelectOptionSchema` is registered in `IMPORTED`. The new crossing is measured, and the key-set reads in the twin go through `stripImportedDefaults`.

New pin: `select-option-form-view-boundary-12736.test.ts`. It covers:
- (a) the zod refusal of `kind` and of `default`, each behind an accepting control;
- (b) the key-set equality against `FormSelectOptionSchema`, at type level and at runtime;
- (c) `@ts-expect-error` on `kind` and `default` in a typed literal;
- (d) a CONTROL showing that `SelectOptionBase`, `SelectOptionMetadata` and the spec's object-field option still take both.

The mutation was applied through `ablation-replace` (anchor x1 to x0, blob 7127370930f3 to 7f3cd87dbd00). The restore was proven by blob hash equal to HEAD (7127370930f3), and `git diff HEAD` was empty.
